text: The bottle says MRP twenty rupees. The shop wants twenty-five, because it's chilled.
Packaged goods must carry a maximum retail price, and it already includes all taxes.
A shop can't sell above it, chilled or not.
Restaurants and hotels serving you are a different case.
Overcharged? Keep the bill, snap the label, and contact the National Consumer Helpline: 1 9 1 5.
